items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: Frank Rhodes and I graduated from high school in 1954

ctx.x: Interesting. Well you said something about going to Chicago because you thought you were going to get into —

Right. See when I graduated, [s/l] Frank Rhodes and I graduated from high school in 1954, so my sister and my brother-in-law and my mother were living in Chicago at the time. So she said well you come here and we’ll try to send you to the Chicago Conservatory of Music. Because I had about three or four scholarships, one to Tennessee State, Arkansas State, Jackson College and some other place. But I turned them down because I wanted to be able to get to Chicago which was a larger city and a better environment…
Did you have music scholarships to these places?
